name: @educateos/portability
description: EducateOS learner portability (roadmap P01): the deterministic `.educateos` student archive, its exporter (policy-checked, rights-enforced, with internal IDs cross-mapped to export-local ones), bounded archive validation, a git fast-import export of an artifact's history, and the CLR 2.0 seam; and cross-district transfer (roadmap P02): consent, signed transfer packages, learner-carried and direct channels that never touch the root, the destination importer, and the portable learner identity link. A library, not a deployable Worker.
